scenes.description: Fish of three sizes, bubbles, seaweed on a sandy bed, a boat on the surface and, now and then, a whale crossing the deep water under a sky that warms to the horizon
scenes.reduced: Everything swims at half speed, fewer bubbles rise and the highlights on the water are fewer and slower

scenes.description: Rain at three depths on a wet evening street under drifting cloud, with lit windows, street lamps mirrored in the road, puddles ringing, someone walking under an umbrella and a distant bolt of lightning every few seconds at most
scenes.reduced: No lightning at all; the rain, the cloud and the walker move at half speed

scenes.description: Flakes at three depths drifting down over two lines of hills with snowy pines, settling into a bank along the bottom. A winter night on dark themes and a snowy day on light ones
scenes.reduced: Flakes fall and sway at half speed

scenes.description: Stars that brighten and fade slowly over a faint band of the galaxy and two low lines of hills, a crescent moon and now and then a slow shooting star. On light themes the same sky at dawn with the last few stars
scenes.reduced: Stars take twice as long to change, shooting stars are rarer and slower

scenes.description: Columns of characters falling in the theme's syntax colours, each with a bright head and a tail that fades away
scenes.reduced: Columns fall at most three rows a second and their characters are never swapped

scenes.description: A meadow at dusk under a moon, with hills, a line of trees, one great tree and long swaying grass, where lights drift and pulse slowly. On light themes a summer afternoon with a sun, clouds, wild flowers, butterflies and drifting pollen
scenes.reduced: Pulses take at least twice as long, the lights wander at under half the speed and the grass sways at half speed

scenes.description: Two or three slow curtains of colour across the upper sky over a ridge of snow-capped peaks, a starry night on dark themes and the blue hour on light ones
scenes.reduced: The curtains drift and breathe at half speed

scenes.description: A campfire in a clearing ringed by pines, flames whose rows take a new shape one at a time, each at most once every 0.6 seconds, over logs on a bed of coals inside a ring of stones, with rising embers and a steady glow
scenes.reduced: Each row changes at most once every 1.5 seconds, fewer and slower embers

scenes.description: A calm sea to the horizon under a sun, with gulls crossing the sky
scenes.reduced: Slower swell and slower wing beats

scenes.description: The Zacess mark at about half the screen's height, floating slowly round the middle over a soft wash with two ribbons of colour flowing across it
scenes.reduced: The mark floats and the ribbons flow at half speed

scenes.description: A stream winding through a forest towards the viewer, trunks at three depths under the canopy, shafts of light drifting slowly across them, ripples flowing downstream, leaves riding the current, stones and ferns on the banks and motes of dust in the light
scenes.reduced: The water, the leaves, the light and the motes move at half speed

scenes.description: Dunes in three ranges under a starry sky, a moon rising over a few minutes and then holding, a caravan of camels on the far ridge, a cactus and now and then a slow shooting star; at sunrise in light themes, with a pale sun over golden dunes and no stars
scenes.reduced: Stars change half as often, the moon and the camels move at half speed and there are no shooting stars

scenes.description: Rooftops at dusk from a high window: a far skyline, a terrace whose windows light up and go dark one at a time, then near slate roofs with chimney stacks, smoke, aerials and pigeons on the ridges, one now and then flying to another roof; late afternoon in light themes
scenes.reduced: Windows change half as often and the smoke, the clouds and the pigeons move at half speed

scenes.description: A pond seen from above with lily pads and a few water lilies, frogs that hop from pad to pad now and then with rings of ripples and dragonflies darting between hovers
scenes.reduced: Frogs hop half as often, the ripples and the light on the water move at half speed and the dragonflies dart more slowly still

scenes.description: A garden pond from above in solid colour, with koi seen from above swimming slow curves past lily pads by the banks and a soft ripple now and then
scenes.reduced: Koi swim and turn at half speed with a tail sweep half as wide and half as quick; ripples come less often and spread more slowly

scenes.description: A harbour town at night, with lit houses behind a stone quay, lamps and their long shimmering reflections, moored boats swaying at their masts, a striped lighthouse and a passing ferry; a sunny afternoon with clouds in light themes
scenes.reduced: Masts stay still and the water stops lapping, the shimmer changes half as often and the ferry and clouds are slower

scenes.description: Glowing paper lanterns rising slowly from a dark lake at three depths, each with a soft halo and a reflection that slides down the water as it climbs; a dusk sky in light themes
scenes.reduced: Lanterns rise, sway and drift at half speed

scenes.description: Striped, shaded hot air balloons in three sizes lifting from behind three ridges of rolling hills under soft drifting clouds, in a dawn sky or a day sky in light themes
scenes.reduced: Balloons rise and drift at half speed and the clouds move at half speed

scenes.description: A steam train crossing open country on a golden evening, with hills, a patchwork of fields, trees and a fence sliding past at their own speeds; a clear day in light themes
scenes.reduced: Every layer slides at half speed and smoke puffs half as often

scenes.description: A log cabin in the snow at night, with a lit window, chimney smoke, snowy pines and gently falling snow; a winter afternoon in light themes
scenes.reduced: Snow and smoke move at half speed and smoke puffs less often

scenes.description: A shaded tree in autumn colour dropping leaves that turn as they drift down and gather in a pile, with geese crossing now and then, on an evening; a clear afternoon in light themes
scenes.reduced: Leaves fall, drift and come loose at half the rate without turning and the geese fly at half speed

scenes.description: A flowering branch letting petals go on a breeze, down to a stream that carries them away, with a bird on the branch, under a pink evening sky; a clear day in light themes
scenes.reduced: Petals fall and float at half speed without turning and fewer come loose; the bird looks half as often

scenes.description: A night skyline where windows light and darken one at a time, a moon, a river and a train that crosses a bridge now and then; dusk in light themes
scenes.reduced: Windows change half as often, the ripples move at half pace and the train is slower and rarer

scenes.description: A shaded, banded planet with a broad ring that passes behind it and in front of it, with a moon on a slow 40 second orbit; a bright planet on a pale sky in light themes
scenes.reduced: The moon takes 80 seconds to go round and the storm crosses at half speed

scenes.description: Stars in a painted night sky over a line of wooded hills, joined slowly into named figures, one group at a time, held and then faded; the blue hour in light themes
scenes.reduced: Lines are drawn at half speed and the hold and fade steps take twice as long

scenes.description: A mug of tea with curling steam, books, a plant and a lamp, with rain or snow at the window
scenes.reduced: Fewer, slower puffs of steam and slower weather

scenes.description: A ginger cat asleep on a cushion, breathing slowly, with drifting z's, wool on the rug and a night window; the window shows a day sky in light themes
scenes.reduced: Breaths, the tail and the z's take twice as long

scenes.description: A flower bed in front of a picket fence and a hedge whose seeds sprout, grow and bloom over a season of about two minutes, with butterflies, before the bed starts again
scenes.reduced: The season takes twice as long, wings beat half as often and the clouds and butterflies move at half speed

scenes.description: A grid of small shaded pages with the Zacess fold, one tile changing colour at a time
scenes.reduced: Tiles change half as often

scenes.description: Broad ribbons of shaded silk that twist as they flow slowly across the screen, each casting a soft shadow on what lies behind it
scenes.reduced: The ribbons flow and twist at half speed

scenes.description: Rows of sunflowers at three depths swaying as the wind passes along the field, under a warm sky with a low sun, with bees drifting between the heads
scenes.reduced: The sway is slower and smaller and the bees and clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: Three ranges and a line of pines mirrored in a still lake at sunrise, the sun's rim in a notch of the peaks, mist on the water, a slow ripple through the reflection and a heron fishing in the shallows
scenes.reduced: The ripple, the swell, the mist and the cloud bands move at half speed and the heron holds each pose twice as long, so its rings come half as often

scenes.description: Rock pools at low tide in shaded rocks with weed round the pools, light shimmering over the water, anemones waving, starfish on the bottom and crabs walking sideways across the sand
scenes.reduced: The shimmer is slower and sparser, tentacles wave less and more slowly and crabs walk at half speed and rest twice as long

scenes.description: Folded paper boats in five colours drifting down a stream at three distances, ripples carried along by the current and reeds swaying on both banks
scenes.reduced: Boats, ripples and clouds drift at half speed and the reeds sway less and more slowly

scenes.description: A row of tower mills from near to far over a patchwork of furrowed fields and hedges, each with a red cap and four latticed sails turning slowly, clouds drifting overhead
scenes.reduced: Sails turn and clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: A checked blanket with a wicker basket on a grassy hill beside a shady tree, kites flying overhead on long strings with rippling tails and clouds drifting by
scenes.reduced: Kites and clouds drift at half speed and the tails ripple half as fast and less widely

scenes.description: A quadcopter flying in over rolling country, a faint beam from its sensor mapping the ground below as a line of dots on the land's own contour, then a hover, a slow descent onto a marked pad, its rotors spinning down and a POSITION FIX GOOD readout
scenes.reduced: The whole approach takes twice as long and the beam sweeps and the hover bobs half as often

scenes.description: A kitchen counter with a kettle on its base, a mug with a tea bag in it and a window onto a garden: bubbles rise in the kettle's gauge and its lid rattles, steam curls from the spout, the switch clicks off and the kettle lifts and pours into the mug, then steam rises from the cup
scenes.reduced: The story takes twice as long, steam rises and sways at half speed with fewer puffs, the lid rattles half as often and the cloud drifts at half speed

scenes.description: A rocket rolling in on its tracked platform to a pad on the coast beside a lattice gantry, the access arm swinging in and away while a board counts down, a glow swelling under it at zero as smoke billows out along the ground, then lift-off and a long trail climbing into the sky and thinning away before the next rocket rolls in
scenes.reduced: The whole launch runs at half pace, so the board changes every two seconds and the glow takes eight seconds to swell; the sea, the surf and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: A pit lane side on with the lit garage behind, where a race car slides into its box, goes up on the jacks, has its wheels changed by gunners and carriers and pulls away when the lollipop lifts, the board showing its stop time, before the carriers fetch new wheels for the next car
scenes.reduced: The car slides, the crew walk and the wheels move at half speed, so each stop takes twice as long

scenes.description: A circuit board on a workbench under an angled lamp, with an oscilloscope and a bench supply, where the LEDs along the board light one after another until the status LED glows a steady green, the POWER GOOD legend lights up and the scope settles on a square wave, then the supply switches off and the chain lights again
scenes.reduced: LEDs light and fade half as often and the scope's beam holds still

scenes.description: Rain slanting in a strong wind at three depths under three banks of cloud, a tree in full leaf bending in the gusts on a hill above a field with a hedgerow and a cottage. A bolt of lightning every 5 to 9 seconds at most, never in the first five
scenes.reduced: No lightning at all, a third less rain falling at half speed and a sway half as quick

scenes.description: A street already awash where the water rises slowly past the doors and a parked car, then holds with a gentle swell and debris drifting along the surface
scenes.reduced: The water rises, swells and drifts at half speed and the drizzle is halved

scenes.description: A container ship on a grey sea that settles by the bow over a minute as its waterline creeps up past the portholes, then rolls gently while a lifebuoy and a crate drift away
scenes.reduced: It lists, rolls and drifts at half speed, the rain is halved and fewer highlights cross the sea

scenes.description: Lapped steel plates fixed with rows of rivets where rust creeps out from a few rivets, crusts and flakes, with rusty stains running down and a drop sliding down each now and then
scenes.reduced: The rust spreads, the stains run and the drops slide at half speed

scenes.description: Round cables hanging from a patch panel, already crossed, that slowly wander, loop and knot into a swaying snarl trailing over the floor, with one port's link light gone red
scenes.reduced: The cables tangle and sway at half speed

scenes.description: Potted plants on a sill before a window of hard sun whose stems droop over, flowers fade to dry heads, leaves dry and fall onto the sill and soil cracks
scenes.reduced: The plants wilt, sway and drop leaves at half speed

scenes.description: A country road at dusk bending away between hedges, lamps, marker posts and signs, where a bank of fog rolls in from the distance and swallows all but the nearest stretch while the lamps glow dimly through it
scenes.reduced: The fog rolls in and drifts at half speed

scenes.description: A bridge over a flowing river with its middle span gone, girders hanging, the fallen span in the water, a barrier with a BRIDGE OUT board and a waiting car
scenes.reduced: The river and clouds move at half speed and fragments fall half as often

scenes.description: A split pipe in a brick basement lit by a bare bulb, dripping into a pail that fills, brims over and spreads into a puddle that holds, with a damp stain creeping down the wall
scenes.reduced: Drips come half as often and fall at half speed, so the pail fills and the puddle spreads twice as slowly

scenes.description: A night skyline whose lit windows go dark one at a time beside a snapped power line, leaving a few candles and windows on their own power, at dusk in light themes
scenes.reduced: The windows go dark at half the rate and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: Cars, hatchbacks and vans queued bumper to bumper on a two lane road behind a signal stuck on red, with cones, a ROAD CLOSED board and exhaust drifting up, at dusk or by day in light themes
scenes.reduced: The last cars roll in at half speed, puffs come half as often and the puffs and clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: A chalk cliff edge crumbling into the sea, stones tumbling and splashing and a fence left hanging over the drop until the face reaches harder rock
scenes.reduced: Pieces break away half as often and fall at half speed

scenes.description: A plain of cracked mud plates shrinking towards a hazy horizon under a heavy sun, more cracks opening edge by edge, a dry riverbed whose last puddle dries to a damp stain, a dead tree with its long shadow, drifting dust and a gliding bird
scenes.reduced: The cracks open and the puddle dries at half the rate and the dust and the bird move at half speed

scenes.description: A ridged volcano at dusk with two ranges behind it, a glowing crater, a plume of ash with embers lifting in it and three lava flows that break out one after another, creep down the gullies and spread into glowing pools on the plain
scenes.reduced: The lava creeps, the pools spread and the ash and embers rise at half speed

scenes.description: Boulders breaking loose under a pale scar high on a layered mountainside and tumbling down in heavy hops, raising dust where they strike and heaping up across the road against a striped barrier until it is blocked, then only the odd pebble
scenes.reduced: Boulders come a quarter as often and fall at half speed, the dust settles at half the rate and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: A towering wall of dust rolling in from the right over mesas, two ranges of dunes and a line of telegraph poles, swallowing them and finally the low sun while sand streams past, with the near pole and a wire fence left clear
scenes.reduced: The wall rolls in, its billows stir and the sand streams past at half speed

scenes.description: A frozen lake under a moon with snowy hills and pines on the far shore, cracks running out in a star from one weak point, branching and joined by a ring, a ragged hole of dark water opening, light snow and reeds in a drift on the near bank
scenes.reduced: The cracks spread and the hole opens at half the rate and the snow falls at half speed

scenes.description: A circuit board with a processor, a smaller chip, a crystal, resistors, capacitors and edge fingers where one trace has burnt through: the copper blackens back along it, a scorch spreads round the break, a soft glow swells and a few slow sparks and a thin curl of smoke rise from it
scenes.reduced: Bursts of sparks come half as often with two sparks each, the glow swells half as fast and the damage spreads and the smoke rises at half the rate

scenes.description: Vines climbing a brick wall, its two capped posts and the bars of its iron gate while weeds push up between the paving slabs, taller nearer the viewer, until the path is lost and the gate half hidden
scenes.reduced: The growth takes twice as long and the tips stir half as often

scenes.description: The `drone-landing` approach where the mapped dots scatter above and below the ground instead of following it: the drone hovers over the pad with no match, its lamp turns amber and it climbs calmly away to hold high over the field beside a NO TERRAIN MATCH readout
scenes.reduced: The whole approach and the climb take twice as long, the beam sweeps and the hover bobs half as often and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: The `kettle-boil` counter where the kettle's lamp comes on and goes off again four seconds later with the water barely stirring: no steam, an empty mug and a note pinned by it that says try again
scenes.reduced: The click and the note come at half the pace, the bubble climbs half as fast and the cloud drifts at half speed

scenes.description: The same coastal pad with the rocket held on its platform: the board reads HOLD, the gantry's access arm swings slowly back in and steam vents from the rocket's sides and drifts off on the wind, with a low mist round the platform
scenes.reduced: The arm swings back and the steam drifts at half pace and the sea, the surf and the clouds drift at half speed

scenes.description: The same pit stop where the front wheel is changed but the rear one will not come off, its hub marked in the error colour, the crew gathering round while the car waits on its jacks and the time on the board climbs
scenes.reduced: The car is already waiting in its box, the crew gather at half speed and the board ticks half as often

scenes.description: The same bench where one LED in the chain stays dark, the status LED and the POWER GOOD legend stay unlit and the probe moves slowly from the mat to the dark LED while the scope sweeps along a flat trace
scenes.reduced: The probe moves at half speed and the scope's beam holds still

soundSets.sound: Soft bells with a little shimmer, the original tones
Warm wooden bars, short and round
Plucked metal tines with a gentle ring
A soft synth pad that swells in and fades out
Gentle 8-bit square waves, rounded so they never buzz
Slow glassy tones like a wet finger on a rim
A soft grand piano, felt hammers and a warm low ring
Water droplets over a quiet bed of rain
